judge_notes.opus5: Item 1 is careful work on the line that has set the sign of every recent print (the Q4 comp is easy and a guide on the Q3 guide's two-year stack lands ~1.5% above a ~$1.52bn consensus, worth 4-8 points at the measured sensitivity), and item 6 gives a de-risked entry after -10.8% in five sessions with calls bid. Item 5 is what offsets it almost entirely: a CFO three days into the job setting his first Q4 guide, with relative-TSR equity, has every reason to set a beatable number, and this stock loses double digits on a soft guide.
judge_notes.opus55: An easy Q4 comp under a Q4 consensus the stock trades on (i1), a habitual guide overshoot (i0) and de-risked positioning with buyback capacity (i6, i7), against a new CFO setting his first guide and Europe (i5, i2).
judge_notes.sonnet55: Guide-beating habit and easy Q4 comp after a 10.8% de-risking slide, against Alphabet ad deceleration and a new CFO's first guide; four of five prints sold, so small lean.
judge_notes.fable51: The Q4 guide laps the tariff-hit 14% quarter so a stack-consistent guide sits ~1.5% above a consensus held flat for 30 days, the quarter overshoots its guide habitually, and the stock de-risked 11% in five sessions; a new CFO's first guide and Europe are the risks.
